zh.title: 開羅航空於阿拉敏航展訂購15架空中巴士A320neo客機
zh.summary: 開羅航空簽署15架空中巴士A320neo訂單；計畫2034年前機隊達130架
body: 埃及的開羅航空（Air Cairo）於2026年9月8日在2026年阿拉敏國際航展上，與空中巴士（Airbus）正式簽署15架A320neo客機的確認購買訂單。這項協議標誌著該航空公司首次直接向空中巴士採購飛機，開啟自持機隊資產與租賃客機並行的營運模式。
根據空中巴士與開羅航空公布的細節，這批新訂購的空中巴士A320neo客機採用單一客艙配置，最高可搭乘186名乘客。該機型採用新一代發動機與空氣動力學設計，每座燃油消耗及二氧化碳排放量均較前一代窄體客機減少至少百分之二十。開羅航空預計利用新機擴展定期與旅遊航線網路，連結埃及本土與歐洲、非洲及中東地區。
開羅航空董事長兼執行長謝里夫（Hussein Sherif）表示，將自持飛機與租賃機隊相結合，可在公司擴大規模時提供更高的營運靈活性與財務效益。謝里夫指出，A320neo客機將提供擴展網路所需的運力，滿足往返埃及日益增長的旅遊需求，並在與空中巴士的合作下支持埃及航空與觀光產業發展。
空中巴士民用飛機業務銷售執行副總裁聖埃克蘇佩里（Benoît de Saint-Exupéry）指出，這是開羅航空首次直接向空中巴士採購飛機，展現出該公司對A320neo機型的信心。他表示，A320neo能夠提供優異的效率與彈性，協助開羅航空擴大航網，強化埃及與國際主要目的地之間的交通連結。
開羅航空近年的機隊規模持續成長，已從五年前的7架客機大幅增長至目前的45架以上。該公司的長期目標是在2034年前將機隊擴充至130架以上。開羅航空現有機隊除空中巴士窄體客機外，亦營運ATR 72雙螺旋槳客機與巴西航空工業E190（ICAO機型代碼E190）區域客機，並以開羅、赫加達及沙姆沙伊赫等主要機場為營運基地。

en.title: Air Cairo Places Firm Order for 15 Airbus A320neo Aircraft at El Alamein Airshow
en.summary: Air Cairo orders 15 Airbus A320neos to expand its network and scale its fleet by 2034.
body: Egyptian carrier Air Cairo signed a firm order with Airbus for 15 A320neo narrowbody aircraft on September 8, 2026, at the El Alamein International Airshow 2026. The agreement marks the airline's first direct purchase order from Airbus, establishing direct aircraft ownership to complement its existing leased fleet.

The A320neo aircraft will be configured in Air Cairo's single-class passenger layout carrying up to 186 passengers. Equipped with new-generation engines, the type delivers at least a 20 percent reduction in fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emissions per seat compared with previous-generation aircraft. The new jets will support scheduled and leisure services connecting Egypt with destinations across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.

Hussein Sherif, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Air Cairo, stated that combining owned aircraft with the carrier's leased fleet offers enhanced operational flexibility and financial efficiency during expansion. Sherif noted that the A320neo will provide the needed capacity to serve growing travel demand to and from Egypt while supporting the nation's aviation and tourism sectors.

Benoît de Saint-Exupéry, Airbus Executive Vice President of Sales for Commercial Aircraft, welcomed Air Cairo's first direct acquisition. He emphasized that the commitment highlights the airline's confidence in the A320neo to power its next growth phase while delivering the efficiency required to scale connectivity across regional and international networks.

Air Cairo has expanded rapidly from seven aircraft five years ago to a fleet of over 45 aircraft today, incorporating Airbus narrowbodies, ATR 72 turboprops, and Embraer E190 (ICAO type code E190) regional jets. The airline aims to scale its fleet to more than 130 aircraft by 2034, operating domestic and international routes from bases including Cairo, Hurghada, and Sharm El Sheikh.

zh.title: 易捷航空因租賃客機爭議面臨租賃公司7200萬美元索償訴訟
zh.summary: 易捷航空因終止六架空中巴士客機租約，遭俄資租賃公司起訴索償至少7200萬美元。
body: 英國廉價航空公司易捷航空（easyJet）目前在倫敦高等法院面臨一項索償金額至少達7200萬美元的法律訴訟。該起訴訟涉及六架租賃的空中巴士客機，起訴方指控易捷航空以歐盟對俄羅斯實施制裁為由終止租賃合約並棄置相關飛機。易捷航空則明確表示，將針對此案進行全面抗辯。

提出訴訟的實體為 STLC Europe Eight Leasing Limited，該公司為愛爾蘭註冊的飛機租賃公司，隸屬於俄羅斯國營國家運輸租賃公司（GTLK）旗下的 GTLK Europe。愛爾蘭高等法院已於2023年5月31日下令將 GTLK Europe 及 GTLK Europe Capital 進行清算，並指定清算人出售其資產以向債權人償還債務。本次對易捷航空發起的訴訟即為該清算程序與資產追討行動的一環。
根據《金融時報》報導，該項索償金額包含至少3670萬美元的未付租金與利息、3250萬美元的飛機價值損失，以及約280萬歐元的機場相關費用。涉案的六架空中巴士客機在俄羅斯全面入侵烏克蘭前即已停飛，自2020年3月起即因全球嚴重特殊傳染性肺炎（COVID-19）疫情影響而處於封存狀態。
雙方在制裁規定與維修責任上存在嚴重分歧。易捷航空指出，歐盟針對俄羅斯實施的航空制裁政策使其無法對這些飛機進行正常的維護與修復作業。然而起訴方 STLC Europe Eight 對此說法表示異議，主張涉案飛機當時均存放於俄羅斯境外，且租賃公司本體註冊於愛爾蘭，因此不應受相關維護限制影響。
在涉案飛機的現況方面，原先存放於賽普勒斯的三架空中巴士客機隨後已由清算人收回並完成出售，但清算人指出飛機狀況不佳導致最終出售價格受損。另一方面，存放於西班牙麥德林（Madrid）的另外三架空中巴士客機至今仍尚未出售，全案後續將由倫敦高等法院審理。

en.title: easyJet Faces $72 Million High Court Lawsuit Over Leased Airbus Aircraft
en.summary: easyJet faces a $72 million lawsuit in London over six leased Airbus A319 aircraft.
body: British low-cost carrier easyJet is facing a lawsuit in London's High Court seeking at least $72 million over six leased Airbus aircraft. The legal action alleges that easyJet abandoned the aircraft after invoking European Union sanctions against Russia to terminate their leasing contracts. In response, easyJet stated that it will defend the case in full before the court.

The lawsuit was filed by STLC Europe Eight Leasing Limited, an Irish aircraft-leasing subsidiary of GTLK Europe, which serves as the international leasing division of Russia's state-owned State Transport Leasing Company (GTLK). Ireland's High Court placed GTLK Europe and GTLK Europe Capital into liquidation on May 31, 2023, appointing liquidators to sell off assets and recover funds owed to repay creditors.

According to a report by the Financial Times, the legal claim comprises at least $36.7 million in unpaid rent and interest, $32.5 million in lost aircraft value, and €2.8 million in airport fees. The six aircraft involved in the dispute had been grounded since March 2020 during the collapse in air travel caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, well before Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

easyJet contended that EU aviation sanctions against Russia legally prevented it from maintaining or repairing the leased aircraft. However, STLC Europe Eight rejected this argument, maintaining that the aircraft were located outside of Russia in Cyprus and Spain and that the leasing company was incorporated in Ireland, meaning maintenance should not have been restricted.

Regarding the current status of the aircraft, three Airbus A319 jets stored in Cyprus were recovered and sold, though liquidators noted that their degraded condition resulted in reduced sale prices. The remaining three aircraft stored in Madrid have not been sold, as legal proceedings continue in London.
